My dear [Selina](../persons.html#1048)
The Old Solitary Wasp has been excited to write out some recollections of this county in verse which may amuse some of the young Busy Bees.
I enclose my subscription, hoping it is right, but I am not sure

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: With envelope addressed to Miss Moor/ Ampfield Vicarage/ Romsey and postmarked 28 November 1879.

Selina Moor (b. 1859/60) was the daughter of the Rev.

John Frewen Moor.

Probably she was the editor of a parish magazine.
